batting.dismissal: c Q de Kock b Ashwani Kumar

balls.text: That's some way to get your maiden IPL century! Swings a short ball over square leg and it's been an innings of struggle and redemption! He was on 19 off 22, and he finishes unbeaten on 101 off 45! The second timeout break changed everything for him, and he's managed to single-handedly take Mumbai Indians to a very competitive score!
One down, one to go! Full toss around off and Tilak gets down on one knee and helps it along over fine leg
Low full toss outside off, driven out to deep point
Gets this one right in the blockhole, and Tilak can only work it down to long-on
Just over a leaping fielder! Banged in short on leg and Tilak swivels and pulls it away. Rabada was stationed there, but he got it over him
Not immediately, he can't! Prasidh goes too full around off and angled across, Tilak carves it over backward point with a an open blade. No one in the deep there so it was a safe effort
Siraj nails the yorker. 140kph, just outside off and angled across. Rutherford brought down the bat with an open face, but gets nothing on that

Phillips adds to his collection of screamers! Siraj with a 140kph full toss, low on leg. Pandya looks to jab it away and it's to Phillips' right. Pandya didn't hit it well enough but could have banked on the placement doing the job, but Phillips is one of the quickest in the deep and he puts in the dive to take it. It's probably not among the most difficult catches he's taken, but a very good one nonetheless. Pandya's struggles come to an end
In the blockhole on middle, whipped away through midwicket
Beats long-on, does Tilak. Low full toss on off and Tilak hammers this down the ground. Too straight for long-on

Lovely yorker! Did he get some bat on that, because otherwise it looked pretty plumb. Gill comes in, has a word and reviews. Yeah, clear inside edge onto the pads, after which it deflected towards point
Starts with a short ball outside off. Pandya manages to bash it over mid-off, even as his bottom hand came off the bat
Tilak goes down in a heap, after copping a blow as he misses this 150.3kph back of length delivery. He looks in severe pain. I reckon anyone would be, if they were hit in the box at that pace!
Flies over long-off! Ashok misses his mark again as he serves up another slot ball. Tilak, with a strong base, hits a lofted drive down the ground and gets enough elevation and distance on it
20 off this over off four balls! This is the Tilak Varma we are more used to seeing! Back-of-hand slower ball, in the slot outside off, and Tilak slog-sweeps it over midwicket
Goes for the wide yorker, but it's not full enough. Tilak slaps it down the ground and beats mid-off!

Almost a chance at short fine leg. Tilak shuffles across to this back of length delivery outside offf. Goes for the scoop and miscues it, and it's almost a catch. But it drops short of him and beats his dive
Fifty up in style! This is short and wide and he carves it over point with a strong cut shot
Clipped to the bowler's right and with no one in the midwicket region, they pick up two with ease
Tossed up full, Tilak has to reach forward and chips it wide of long-on on the bounce
On a length around off, tucked through midwicket
A bit of a long hop and Tilak pulls it out to deep midwicket on the bounce

On a length on off and angled across, Tilak punches this with beautiful placement through cover. Glenn Phillips runs across from deep point and flies Superman-style. But, despite his best efforts, he did crash into the ropes before pushing the ball away
Bam! This is tossed up full and wide and Tilak frees his hands and gives it a good whack straight down the ground. Sails over the sightscreen
Back of length delivery, tucked behind square. Rabada's sensational spell comes to an end
Looks for the yorker but it ends up a low full toss. Pandya was skipping out and he manages to work it down to long-on
Again Rabada beats Hardik with a back-of-length delivery that the batter tries to steer down to deep third
Pandya looks to work this back of length delivery fine on the off side as he adjusts late but is beaten on the off side
Short outside off, Pandya has a waft but can't connect
Nearly does with a 142kph full ball outside off. Pandya looked to go inside out but ends up slicing it. Clears the cover fielder racing back
On a length outside off, tapped in front of point for a single

Full toss angled across him, Tilak opens the bat face to steer it down to deep third. MI review for a waist-high no ball. And the replays show the ball passed him exactly at his waist height so it's not going to be a no-ball.
Now he bangs it in short on leg angling it across Tilak, who leaves it be as the umpire calls it wide
Tilak skips out and Prasidh looks for a yorker outside off. Squeezed out through point
Tilak on a roll! Three boundaries in a row. Prasidh overpitches again, with some width at 146kph, and Tilak bashes a lofted drive wide of long-off
And now he scoops Prasidh over fine leg! That's another slower ball and Tilak shuffles across and nails the scoop
Tilak looks to shift gears! This is a slower ball at 123kph, and it's too full. Tilak handsomely lofts it over long-off
Beats him all ends up! 143.9kph delivery jags in from a good length outside off. Pandya was too slow to react
Full outside off, driven through cover point for a couple
Goes short and across again, Tilak scuffs the pull through midwicket
Slower bouncer outside off, Pandya leaves. But Buttler gets deceived by the ball bouncing in front of him and it ricochets to deep fine leg
Short ball on leg, pulled away through midwicket
Full around off, 147.7kph. Tilak looks to carve it on the off side but it goes to point on the bounce
Pandya skips out again and looks thrash this 144kph full ball down the ground. Only manages an inside edge onto his pads
Back of length around leg, clipped to deep square leg
Skips out of his crease first up and punches a length ball to mid-off and takes off for a quick single. If the throw at the non-striker's end was on target, Hardik was likely a goner

And Prasidh gets on the board! Short ball does the trick. Angled into Dhir, who looks to pull it away, but doesn't get the distance on it. Rabada runs in from deep square leg and takes the catch diving forward
Back of length and angled across him, pulled away through midwicket for a single
Tilak looks to skip down the track and Prasidh pulls his length back. Tilak blocks it back to the bowler
Punched to long-on's right for a couple more runs
Tucked off his pads for a single
Full around off, he gets forward and works it in front of square leg. Rashid runs quick to intercept and prevent the single
Full on off, clipped through square leg and they are able to run two
Taps this length ball through point
On a length outside off, punched down to long-on
Full outside off, eased in front of point. 13-run over, could this be the one that shifts the momentum?
On a length outside off, punched back to the bowler
Darted in on a length outside leg, clipped through midwicket
Goes down the ground again! This time he doesn't get the same distance on it, but hits it right in the gap between long-on and long-off. This was a length ball outside off that sat up nicely
Boshed over long-on! This is tossed up in the slot outside off, Dhir gets his balance forward and slogs it away
Full around middle, flicked through midwicket

Misfield costs Titans an extra run. Dhir clips this googly on a length through midwicket. Deep midwicket runs in and the ball wobbles in front of him to go through him. Thankfully, long-on had also come across and it's kept down to just two
Full outside off, spinning in. Tilak works it square on the leg side
Again the length ball stays low. Dhir still adjusts and pulls it down to deep midwicket
Full around leg, goes off his pads towards backward square leg as Tilak misses his flick
Googly on a length on off, stays low as Dhir misses his swipe. Goes off his back foot to the leg side
Tossed up on off, Tilak works it to long-on

Pull back the length just a little. Punched towards covers and they steal a run while Shahrukh runs in. Gill looks a little ticked off about MI stealing a run there, but was quite well-judged from the batters in the end
Dhir's been waiting and watching, but now, he unfurls a splendid drive! Was too full and outside off, Dhir stays still and gets it past long-off
Full outside off, driven to mid-off. Shubman Gill puts in a fantastic dive to save at least a run
Sits up on a length and attacks that line outside off. A rather off-colour drive driven straight to extra cover
Speared in much fuller, outside off. Enough room and pace on the ball for a cracking drive down to deep extra cover
On a length with that high release point of his, just outside off and moving ever so slightly into the batter. Flicked towards mid-wicket
Full and attacking the stumps, this time Dhir shifts slightly down the leg side to drive this towards extra cover
Now still on a length, still on the stumps, spinning away from Dhir. Bunted right back to the bowler
Googly back of a length, spinning right back into Tilak. Goes on the backfoot and gets it to mid-wicket
Slightly pulls back his length, right on the stumps. Flicked behind him, towards fine leg
Speared in full and just outside off. Flicks this down to mid-on
Outside off and full-ish. Dhir happy to flog this down the ground and take off for the other end
Slightly shorter, but well outside off too. There to be cut once more. He just dabs this past a diving Rabada at deep backward point
Impeccable placement on that cut! Was on a length, but too wide of off. Dhir can finally free his arms and pushes this past the running deep point fielder
Full and outside off, Naman drives this straight to Shahrukh once more. He mimes a celebration and gets the crowd going for a bit
A little too full outside off, there to be driven. But hits it straight to the sole fielder in the covers cordon
Full and moving away just slightly. Driven back to the keeper, rushing onto the batter once more because of that speed. 150.3 clicks now...
Bumps into Naman's hips first up! That has to hurt. More extreme pace: 147.3 clicks, skids on from back of a length and rises more than expected. Naman just wants to flick this away but misses it
And now he goes back of a length, around the stumps, to the left-hander once more. Played towards deep fine leg

Absolute ripper, splays all three stumps on the ground! And it's 152.1 clicks - third 150-plus ball of the over! Pace is pace, yaar... Pushes this just a little fuller, and angles this in ever so slightly. SKY, confident from his previous shots, looks to launch this straight down the ground with a cover drive. The ball nips away and goes through bat and ball
On a length and outside off once more. Punches this towards extra cover and takes off
And now he almost chops it back on! Better length from KG. He sends this down back of a length, angled back in from outside off. SKY dabs it to backward point and takes off
And now he boinks it down to long-on! Was too full once more, now just outside off. SKY will be loving this length
There's SKY for you! Too full, and right on the pads down leg. SKY stays still as ever and just helicopters this flick over the long leg boundary
On a length and good bounce on this. 140.5 clicks. Cramps Dhir for room, who tries to flick this towards mid-wicket.
Full-ish and right outside off. Driven towards mid-off, SKY did not time this too well, maybe intentionally, as ball slowed down
Full-ish and angled towards leg side. Frees his hands with a flick towards fine leg and sets off
Full and well outside off, drops just short of Sharukh at covers! Got a leading edge as SKY leaned into that drive
Dhir goes for a huge hoick into the on-side but the ball just thuds into his pads, and dribbles down to point. Missed that all ends up
Back of a length and angled into the stumps, flicked down to mid-wicket
Still back of a length but gives SKY some room outside off. He dabs this late towards backward point and sets off
Back of a length and slanting right into the stumps once more. SKY happy to just defend this one too
Spears it into the blockhole... but slanting far down leg side. Rabada has to reload
Full-ish on the stumps, 147.9 clicks! He defends this into the off side

Rabada's got his second! Rabada went even shorter, cramped QdK with a ball rising at him outside off. He goes for a hoick but the top-edge flies in the air. Rabada pouches this near the short leg area. MI in early trouble
balls.dismissal: Q de Kock — caught and bowled

balls.text: Now he gets the width to cut this away! Whips this back of a length ball from well outside off. Slower 'un punished because of the erring line
Catches the inside edge of the drive. Was full and slanting away from QdK well outside off. Runs down to mid-wicket
Back of a length and keeps low as it swings back in. Defended towards mid-wicket
Fuller and on a fifth stump line. There to be driven. Dhir leans into the drive, but the covers cordon is packed
An inside edge that runs away towards deep fine leg! Siraj finds a better line, swinging it in from outside off. But Dhir's bat does just enough to collect four more
MI's love for the flick continues. Too full and on the pads, Dhir flicks this away towards backward square leg once more
Full-ish and flicked towards backward square leg. Easy single on offer past the gap in the in-field
On a length moving in, flicked off his pads and down to deep square leg
Outside off, back of a length, moves in towards Naman ever so slightly. He gets it down to the covers

Speared in right on the pads. Malewar looks clueless as he tries to lift this one off a good length, but it thuds right into his pads. Never looked like connecting on this one, and he's almost listless as he walks off, once the ump's finger is up. That didn't last long...
Full outside off, he's happy to drive this down to mid-off and take off for the other end
French cut down to the keeper. Stepped down the pitch to this length ball outside off, but QdK's hoick runs behind him
De Kock whips this one over cow corner! Was pitched too full, right at his pads. He watches this one till it reaches under his eyes, then he flicks those wrists like only he can
Outside off and moving away from Malewar, who swishes a defense at this. Outside edge down past point, he runs to the other end
Now a rather whimsical hack outside off. Was speared in on a length but well away from QdK. No feet movement, and in the end, no bat on ball either
Full-ish length, prodding outside off and moving away once more. De Kock happy to play it out to point and just turn the other way, marking out his stance for the next one
Another tetchy prod, a drive this time to this ball fuller and outside off. Dribbles away to backward point. He's off the mark in the IPL!
A familiar ripper from Siraj! Back of a length, right on the off-stump line, and moves away past Malewar's tentative defense
On a length and rearing up at QdK once more. He plays this late towards backward point. Ashok Sharma fumbles there to let them take one
Over the wicket and across the left-hander. Angled away from him and he can only dab it to point

Rapped on the pads and up goes the finger! Siraj sends this up. Looked plumb to me as Siraj missed a slog. No bat on that by a mile. And that's crashing into middle and leg, so Mumbai Indians end their losing streak with a 99-run win, the biggest this season by runs. Mumbai Indians are off the bottom of the table, thanks to Tilak Varma's stunning come-from-behind century and a commanding bowling display.
Now one spins sharply across Siraj, who looks to whip it away but misses
Full outside off, drawing Siraj forward and the ball spins away
Full outside off, Siraj leans forward to defend

Easy does it. Rabada dances down the track and has a huge hoick. The carrom ball spins in too much and it's an easy stumping for de Kock, who gets some semblance of revenge on Rabada for dismissing him in the first innings
Loopy and full outside off, Rabada lunges forward and gets an inside edge onto his pads
Short outside off, pulled in the air and it's too square for deep midwicket running to his left. Ashwani registers his joint-best IPL figures of 4-24, mirroring his heroics from his debut last year
Now a bouncer outside off. Rabada has a swing and misses
Thrashed through extra cover! Back of length delivery sat up nicely outside off and Rabada hits it in the air, but in the gap
Ashwani nails the yorker on middle. Rabada just about keeps it out
Rabada still giving GT fans some consolation boundaries to cheer. This is a length ball angling in from outside off and Rabada smacks it back down the ground
Length ball outside off, Rabada swings and misses and it goes just over the stumps
Great bouncer, and Ashok gets his hands up for protection. Pings off the gloves and onto the vacant square leg region!
On a length and arriving on the pads, flicked out through square leg
Fullish on the pads, clipped through backward square
Looks for that dipping slower yorker on off stump. It pitches a bit outside and Ashok is able to jam his bat down and keep it out
Full on the stumps and sliding down, glanced to deep fine leg
Almost a return catch. Extra bounce on a short ball takes Rabada by surprise and the ball nearly pops back to Bumrah off the bat sticker

Ashwani has a fourth! Bouncer on leg, Shahrukh Khan looks to hook it behind square but it's gone straight to Naman Dhir. That's the last recognised batter for GT, and it feels like it's only a matter of time now that MI can claim to have ended their losing streak
Full outside off, driven out to deep cover
On a length on off, blocked towards mid-off
Length ball seams in from outside off, Rabada blocks
Slapped to cover and taken! Rashid backed away to make room to this length ball and looks to hit it over cover, but doesn't get the elevation. Good catch by sub fielder Raj Bawa above his head
Back of length around leg, Rashid parries towards the leg side
Swung down to long-on
Flighted full outside off, he looks to drive but it goes off the inside half towards long-on
Full on leg, swept fine on the leg side
Flung flatter on a length and Rashid swipes it away through square leg. They pick up two
Tossed up full around middle, Rashid meets it with a textbook front-foot defence
On a length outside off, 75kph, punched out through cover point

The extra ball brings the wicket! Oh boy. This is nicely pitched on a length outside off, Tewatia prods at it with an open face to try and run it down fine on the off side. All he gets is a healthy nick and de Kock gobbles it up
Short and wide, and it's left alone. Called wide. QDK instantly signals a review and Pandya obliges. The DRS shows it to be the correct call. Wide on height
Very full on leg, clipped out through square leg
Dug in short and it's deemed wide on height
Full-ish outside off, he runs it down to deep third
Full outside off again, Tewatia again looks to hoick it away through midwicket but this time he can't time it
On a length outside off, blocked towards mid-on. Think that stayed a touch low as well
Full outside off, 134kph, Tewatia shuffles across and slogs it through midwicket
Rare bad ball from Santner. Full toss hanging outside off, it's hitting practice for Shahrukh as he drives this through to the extra cover boundary, lying vacant

Boshed by Shahrukh through cover's hands! Burst out of them. Was on a length well outside off, had the room Shahrukh needed to free his arms, but the fielder getting at least a hand to it meant it slowed down by the time extra cover ran in to collect
On a length and defended down the pitch, but Santner leaps to his left to cut out a run
Drifting down leg off a good length. Tewatia plays a casual flick towards backward square
Tewatia pre-empts a run down the track, Santner pulls his length back to outside off. Cannot get it past square leg
On a good length outside off, spins back into Tewatia. Driven down to covers

Shahrukh looks to force the issue with a big leap down the pitch, swings this over the long-off ropes! Was a carrom ball, a little too full, and converted into the slot because of Shahrukh's long levers.
On a length and big spin from outside off and into the left-hander. A casual dab that dies right in front of point, and he's got another run. Won't do much for GT right now
Full-ish on a fifth stump line, manages to bunt this down to long-on but again, no boundaries even attempted off this
Full and attacking the stumps from outside off. Spinning back in, tucked down to mid-on but the in-field is perfectly packed right now
On a length and spinning away once more. Tentative prod down the track
On a length and spinning back into the right-hander. Shahrukh defends it straight to the bowler and wears a wry smile. He's not used to consolidating in the ninth over of a chase...
On a length and attacking the stumps, Tewatia can do nothing legitimate off this ball except tuck this towards mid-on
Sloooow and outside off, a gentle nudge down to covers

Another stunner in the field, now from Santner off his own bowling! Bit slower, grips in the surface and then loops away from Phillips. Tries to bunt it down the ground but gets a top-edge to the left of Santner, who dives to complete a two-handed catch
Full and drifting down leg, an easy flick to backward point to start the innings

Absolute stunner from Naman Dhir at cow corner! The ball was back of a length outside off, a long hop in all honesty. Sundar goes on the backfoot and hoicks this across the line. There to be hit for six, and looks like it's going over Dhir. But he hops on one knee, plucks this out of the ground, but comes down to earth again
And he pitches this on a length, right at the stumps. Tucked down to long-on
Full and attacking the stumps. Phillips content with a drive down to long-on
Full outside off, Washington goes on the front foot to counter just how clueless he's been with picking the turn out of his hand. Does well enough to drive him down to mid-off and get off strike

He goes for another huge hoick, down on one knee, but he's deceived in the flight! Slowwww ball, just outside off, and deceives Washy in flight. Can't read which way the ball is turning. As it turns out to be, fortune ensures the ball runs down to deep fine leg
Still kept outside off, a little fuller, but driven straight to Pandya at mid-off
Through him! Almost had 'im there. Much more spin off a length, from outside off. Jumps past bat and pad, over the stumps
On a length, not much turn but it does tuck into the line outside off. Washington happy to pluck this towards covers and take off for a second run

On a length, on the stumps, and it could all be taken off a movie reel being rewinded again and again with this fellow. Phillips defends it back to the bowler once more and has a smile on his face. Great spell so far
Back of a length and rising at Phillips. Defended back down to Krish
On a length, attacking the stumps but without much venom at 133.6 clicks. Flicked towards deep midwicket
On a length and aimed right at the pads. Flick played fine towards deep square leg
Pitches on a length outside off, and moves in to hit him on the pads. A run out chance as the ball dribbles to the right of the batter, but Krish can't get there in time to force a run out
Krish has been consistent with his lines so far. Metronomic on a length outside off, moving in towards him. Flicked towards mid-wicket
Washington puts out the front foot and drives this without much power behind it. Straight to cover once more
Back of a length, on the stumps and moving away from the right-hander. Thumps a drive down to the covers

Ashwani strikes to pluck out the big man! Gill stepped down the pitch, hoicking this ball off a length. Read the line going down leg stump well enough, ball rose into Gill's hips. But the top hand came off Gill's bat and he just didn't get the elevation he needed. Caught at deep asquare leg
Slows down after pitching on a good length, just outside off. Patted down into the pitch
Now wide of off, on a length. Washington reaches far out to thread this out to covers
On a length and rising at Sundar. But it's drifting into a leg side line so he can simply swipe this away towards long leg, which is unprotected
Krish pulls his length back, keeps it outside off. Flicks this towards mid-wicket, but not much power on that
Gill asserts his authority at home once more. Too full, right in the slot outside off. 135.2 clicks but off-radar. Gill plays another drive with a high elbow, down to deep extra cover
Slightly fuller and pitched on the stumps, swinging away once more. Sundar times this flick towards mid-wicket, but can't get it past him
Keeps low! Angled away, well outside off. The left-hander jumps at a late drive, but the ball passes under him
Follows Gill as he rushes down the leg side and down the pitch. On a length and angled into his pads. Flick towards deep midwicket
On a length outside off, moving back into Gill. Driven down to mid-off
Jags back in back of a length, rising at Gill's hips to cramp him up in front of the stumps. But he flicks this down to square leg and sets off for the other end, easy enough
A little fuller, and too much room outside off once more. Gill won't miss out on those. Just rolls his wrists over the ball with this drive. Past the covers once more
Goes for a more cramped line. Back of a length and angled back in, solid defense down to cover

How's Bumrah got the ball to do that? Skids through off a length outside off, looks to be swinging in, then tails towards a straighter line at the last moment. It also keeps low, maybe it hit a small crack somewhere. Either way, beats Gill on the outside edge of his defense
Too full and ample room outside off, so Gill pulls out one of his regal drives! Played past cover, and it's always running away to the ropes after that
Full-ish, swinging well down leg side. Gill goes for a half-hearted flick but just happy to see it drift away
Gill is back on strike, after what feels like a lifetime. Bumrah rears one up off a length and swinging into his pads. Through his flick and thuds his pads

And now Washington shows his tekkers once more! Pandya went for that now-familiar line from over the stumps, angling it well away from the left-hander. But the ball bounces off a length and finds itself cut through the covers cordon. Great timing, better placement
On a length but down leg. Second wide of the over, at 131.8 clicks. Has to reload once more
A perfectly good ball bashed down to long-off! Full, looking for swing from outside off. But batter meets it on the up and holds his pose with a high elbow
Speared in full but well outside off. Angles away from the batter, another leave
On a length but going down leg. Easiest flick you'll get down there, so Washington sends it down to deep fine leg for his first boundary
Back of a length on the stumps, angling away from Washington. Wise leave

That's one to respond! Prodigious swing from outside off, thuds right back into Buttler's pads. He shuffled towards the off side to get in line of the delivery, except it swung in more than he expected. Wickets hitting on umpire's call and he has to walk back

He goes too full and gives just a tad bit too much width, on a fifth stump line. Buttler knows Pandya won't get as much swing out of this new ball, maybe. Leans into this drive and it's racing away past covers in a blink
On a length and prodigious swing back in this time around. Gill careful enough to defend this down the pitch
On a length outside off and moves in just a bit once more, played down to deep backward point
Outside off and now angling back in. Buttler prods this down to covers
Even more swing, hangs it well outside off on a length. Buttler wise enough to let this one alone
On a length and now squares him up! Lands right on the stumps but swings away, catches the outside edge of Buttler's bat

And now he's got one first ball! The drought is over and how! It's bowled full, slanted away from the left-hander and swinging even further away. Inviting a drive, which Sudharsan obliges with, but the swing ensures it takes his outside edge and carries to Krish Bhagat at point
